title: Generate GAFF geometries and charges for QM9
action: Use Open Babel to generate GAFF‑optimized molecular geometries and assign per‑atom GAFF atomic charges for every molecule in the QM9 dataset.
description: Produces the reference charge targets and the first set of molecular structures used for descriptor computation.

title: Compute full 505‑dimensional descriptors from GAFF geometries
action: For each atom in the GAFF geometries, compute neighbor sets N_b(r_c,i) for cutoffs r_c ∈ {1.50,1.75,2.00,2.50} Å. Evaluate the 18 implant functions F1–F18 (Table 1) and compute Q_l(r_c,F,i) via Eqs.(1)–(2) for l ∈ {4,6,8,12,15,18,20}. Append the atomic number a_i to form a 505‑element vector d_i; assemble the global descriptor matrix D_gaff.
description: This is the feature generation step that creates the input matrix for the random forest.

title: Random forest training on full descriptors and importance ranking
action: Train a RandomForestRegressor on D_gaff and the GAFF charges using scikit‑learn with default parameters. Perform fivefold cross‑validation and extract feature importances for the 504 fingerprint components (excluding the atomic number feature).
description: Completes the screening step; the ranking is used to select the top 60 fingerprints.

title: Select top 60 fingerprints
action: Sort the fingerprint components by importance (highest first), take the top 60, and write their identifiers (l, r_c (Å), F_name) and importance values to a CSV file.
description: The screened fingerprint set that the paper reports in Table 2 (ranks 1–60).
output_schema: CSV with columns: rank (int), l (int), rc (float, Å), F_name (string), importance (float). One row per fingerprint, sorted by rank ascending.

title: Evaluate charge and dipole moment prediction on GAFF geometries
action: Using only the top 60 fingerprint features plus the atomic number, train a new RandomForestRegressor on D_gaff with fivefold cross‑validation. Predict charges for all atoms; compute per‑element (H, C, N, O, F) and total R², MAE, MSE. Also compute molecular dipole moments from the predicted charges and GAFF atomic positions, and calculate the R² between those dipole moments and the Open Babel dipole moments.
description: The regression metrics that correspond to Table 3 and Figure 4 in the paper.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'atom_types' (object with keys H, C, N, O, F, each an object with keys R2, MAE, MSE), 'total' (object with R2, MAE, MSE), 'dipole_moment_R2' (float).

title: Compute GAFF charges for DFT geometries
action: Use Open Babel to assign GAFF atomic charges to the DFT‑optimized geometries from QM9 (no geometry optimization, only charge assignment).
description: Provides the reference charges for the DFT‑structure evaluation.

title: Compute 60‑fingerprint descriptors from DFT geometries
action: For each atom in the DFT geometries, compute the same 60 selected fingerprint components (using the definitions from s4) plus the atomic number, forming the descriptor matrix D_dft.
description: Creates the input matrix for the DFT‑based evaluations.

title: Robustness evaluation on DFT geometries (train on DFT, evaluate on DFT)
action: Using the top 60 features, train a new RandomForestRegressor on D_dft and the GAFF charges assigned to DFT geometries, with fivefold cross‑validation. Predict charges, compute per‑element and total R², MAE, MSE, and the molecular dipole moment R².
description: Regression results that match Table 4 and Figure 6 of the paper; load‑bearing because they require a correctly trained model on DFT features.

title: Transfer prediction (train on GAFF, predict on DFT)
action: Take the random forest model trained on GAFF data (from step s5), predict atomic charges for the DFT descriptor matrix D_dft, and compare with the GAFF charges assigned to the DFT geometries. Compute per‑element and total R², MAE, MSE (dipole moment is not reported for this transfer scenario).
description: Corresponds to Table 5 (comparison of predicted charges with Open Babel charges for DFT structures). Load‑bearing because it depends on a model trained on GAFF data.
output_schema: Same structure as regression_results_gaff.json, but without the 'dipole_moment_R2' key.
